verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's MP CLI lets a single token operate "preferences" without manual HTTP calls, and Checkout Pro redirects buyers to a Mercado Pago-hosted payment page, so an agent can plausibly create a priced, hosted checkout link programmatically. However, no product or price catalog objects are documented, the documented payment-link feature is generated in the app/website rather than via the API, and the MCP server's listed tools cover docs search, test users and webhooks, not product or link provisioning. Missing for 10: API-level product and price objects, API-created payment links, MCP tools for provisioning, and any hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent session.
